Notes.Text:
This update for speex fixes the following issue:

- CVE-2026-116741: out-of-bounds write in `speex_bits_read_whole_bytes()` allows attackers to stream crafted Speex data
  to corrupt heap or stack memory and crash applications (bsc#1288101).

Vulnerabilities.Description: Speex (libspeex) through 1.2.1 contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in speex_bits_read_whole_bytes() in libspeex/bits.c that mishandles length truncation for non-owned SpeexBits buffers. Attackers can stream crafted Speex data into buffers set up with speex_bits_init_buffer() or speex_bits_set_bit_buffer() to corrupt heap or stack memory and crash applications.
